description: Add safe production-only offline behavior and validate that the landing's content, image, and price data remain parameterized in src/content.
steps: Create public/sw.js with a versioned cache, app-shell/local-asset precaching, network-first navigation with cached / fallback, cache-first same-origin static assets with network fallback, failed-response protection, cross-origin exclusion, and old-cache cleanup.
Register /sw.js from src/main.tsx only when import.meta.env.PROD and serviceWorker are available, logging registration failures without blocking rendering; leave Vite development unregistered.

Review App.tsx and src/content/*.ts to preserve the existing data boundary for visible copy, photos, product prices, and locale/currency; make only narrowly scoped content-boundary edits if needed and record the result in docs/refinamento/landing/verification.md.
Run build, preview, route, asset, production-registration, and offline fallback checks, then record commands and observed evidence in the landing verification document.
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev does not register the service worker, while a production preview registers /sw.js without preventing React rendering.
The production worker uses a versioned cache, does not cache failed or cross-origin responses, serves cached navigation fallback at / when offline, and leaves /design-system navigable.
Visible landing content, photos, and prices remain supplied by src/content modules rather than newly hardcoded in components.
The documented production build and preview verification passes for /, /design-system, local assets, manifest metadata, and offline root fallback.
verification: From /home/caio/projects/templates/caffino-landing run npm run build and confirm it passes.
Run npm run preview, inspect production registration and offline / fallback in browser DevTools, and verify /design-system renders.
Run npm run dev and confirm no worker is registered and development module errors remain visible.
findings: Implemented public/sw.js with caffino-v1 app/asset caches, required local app-shell precaching, a cached-root presence check before activation, network-first navigation fallback to /, cache-first same-origin static assets, failed-response protection, cross-origin exclusion, and old-cache cleanup. Registered /sw.js only behind import.meta.env.PROD and navigator.serviceWorker availability, with non-blocking error logging. App.tsx remains content-driven through src/content for copy, photos, prices, locale, and currency, and typed footer content supplies contact labels and hrefs. Verification record dated 2026-10-30 22:01 -03:00: `npm run build` passed; `npm run preview` route and asset checks returned HTTP 200 for `/`, `/design-system`, `/sw.js`, `/manifest.webmanifest`, `/icons/caffino-192.png`, and the SVG favicon; manifest inspection and `node --check public/sw.js` passed. Headless Chromium via Playwright 1.64.1 confirmed production registration, cached `/`, online and offline `/design-system`, offline `/` rendering, and zero service-worker registrations under `npm run dev`. Full commands and results are recorded in `docs/refinamento/landing/verification.md`.
